name: write_style_guide
description: Replace the current run's style guide document with the given content. The write is a full overwrite: the previous style guide is discarded, so always pass the complete document rather than a patch. The document is limited to 20,000 characters and to the deployment's tool-output budget; exceeding either limit rejects the write with the exact limits and leaves any previous document unchanged, so condense the document and rewrite it. The style guide location is fixed by the run; there is no path parameter.

detailed: Writes a run's style guide document.
tool {participantRole} is writing the style guide

content.description: The complete style guide document. It replaces the previous style guide in full.
